overview.description: The First Trust Bloomberg Inflation Sensitive Equity ETF (FTIF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of US large- and mid-cap stocks considered to benefit directly or indirectly from inflation increases. Selection of individual holdings are based on both fundamental and technical criteria. FTIF was launched on Mar 13, 2023 and is issued by First Trust.
